messages:
Maria G: Hey folks — customer request for PegasusX-30B landed from AcmeCorp. They want hosted low-latency serving + a 4-bit quant path. Asking for: perf targets, quality regression checks, and an ETA for a pilot. Can someone take initial triage?
Aj Patel: I can pick up perf/latency triage. Need sample prompts + tokenizer from CS. Also: what's their sequence length distribution?
Sophia K: I'll own the quality/eval side. Plan: run MMLU, HellaSwag, Rouge (summarization), TruthfulQA subset, plus our internal regression suite. Need their baseline metrics to compare.
Leo P: Infra note: we have a 4-node A100 slot next Tue-Wed. 4-bit PTQ tests need calibration steps that spike mem; may need a temporary dedicated pool for stable latency numbers. If we want accurate p99 numbers, we should test on both Dedicated and Hosted stacks.
Praveen S: For quant experiments I'd run both PTQ (post-training quant) and a short QAT loop for comparison. Our quant tooling is `quant-experiments` in repo. Example quick command to kick off a smoke run:
```
# smoke eval (local/dev)
run_eval --model pegasusx-30b --suite rouge,mmlu --quant ptq --batch 1 --seq_len 512 --out ./runs/pegasusx_smoke
```
Sophia K: Thanks — I'll prepare the eval config. Requesting sample set: 5k prompts, 1k summarization refs, and a flagged prompt set for hallucination/regression checks. @Jen L can CS provide? :pleading_face:
Jen L: CS confirmed — we can share a 5k prompt sample and the customer acceptance criteria. They expect p99 latency <= 120ms (batch=1), cost target ~ $0.001/token, and <=5% drop on Rouge-L compared to their current hosted model. Sending artifacts to a shared S3 bucket by EOD.
Maria G: Good. Quick checklist so we don't forget: 1) get artifacts & tokenizer, 2) run smoke PTQ, 3) run full eval suites (quality + safety), 4) perf runs on Dedicated + Hosted, 5) produce report + recommended quant profile, 6) decision (pilot or reject).
Praveen S: Add: run calibration sensitivity sweep (per-channel vs per-tensor), log token-level deltas for top-20 prompts. I'll push a small helper that dumps per-example diffs.
Leo P: Who should I book infra for? @Aj Patel or @Sophia K? Need a confirmation by EOD for reservation. Also, we should reserve an isolated Dedicated pool for the p99 test to avoid noisy neighbors.
Aj Patel: I'll take infra booking. Please give me the run window (2-4 hours) and exact GPU type. Prefer A100-80GB for the PTQ calibration.
Sophia K: Target dates: start smoke runs Thurs AM, full evals Thurs PM -> Fri morning. If CS artifacts arrive today, I can start configs tonight. Owner: Sophia (quality), Aj (perf), Praveen (quant experiments). Maria will coordinate customer comms.
Maria G: Assigned. Can we aim to have a short summary (one-pager) by Friday COB? Include: quality delta table, latency p50/p95/p99, token cost estimate, and recommended quant profile (e.g., 4-bit PTQ + bias-correction).
eval-bot: New eval run queued: id=pegasusx-2026-03-19-01. Trigger when owners confirm artifacts available.
Jen L: Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-inference/customer-acme/pegasusx/ — tokenizer (tokenizer.json), vocab.bin, prompts_5k.jsonl, refs_summ_1k.tar.gz. Link shared in DM.
Sophia K: Got them. I'll start a smoke ptq run tonight. Will post partial results in this thread. :eyes:
Aj Patel: Booking infra now for Thu 09:00-13:00 UTC — A100-80GB x4 reserved. Noted for dedicated p99 runs.
Maria G: Perfect. Thanks team — keep updates short here. If major regression shows up, we'll convene a short triage.
Praveen S: Quick note: log formats should include per-token logits and calibration stats. I'll add a small parser.
Sophia K: Smoke run started. Will post initial Rouge/L scores in ~3 hrs.
